messages:
ana-partners: Partner kickoff note: SI + hardware vendor asked for a marketplace private offer that spreads commitment over 18 months. they want an onboarding credit that vests, a hardware rebate handled by the partner, and a joint announcement cadence. need to draft terms quickly.

marta-sales: Sounds doable but we need guardrails. finance will want an amortization cap and renewal cliffs. also need clarity on MDF and whether SI gets referral/commission.

jeff-finance: For modeling: recommend cap onboarding credit at 20-25% of year-1 committed ARR, amortize over first two quarters. require usage verification window and clawback in Y2 if commit not met. send expected commit numbers asap.

sam-engineering: Technical constraints: if they expect steady p95 concurrency ~220 and 1.2k tokens per session peak, we should either reserve a SKU or allow burst only into a defined dedicated pool. otherwise latency SLOs could degrade. will need routing appendix and allowed fallback models.

ana-partners: I'll capture those numbers in the term sheet as placeholders. also asking partner to commit to a 6-week co-marketing prep and a $50k MDF contribution to qualify for joint PR.

liz-gpmkt: Marketing wants two windows: 1) announcement at contract execution, 2) a usage milestone case study at month 6 if they hit >70% of ramp. need assets: logo lock, short quote, one-pager.

rajesh-legal: Key legal asks: define measurement authority (marketplace metering preferred), include audit rights for 12 months post-contract for usage reconciliation, and a clear clawback formula tied to under-delivery. also separate HW rebate language so it doesn't offset our credits unless explicitly reconciled.

marta-sales: Sales tactic: propose a "concierge onboarding" flow in the offer doc that lists success milestones (integration complete, tagging in place, traffic baseline) which trigger portions of the credit vesting. reduces risk.

sam-engineering: Add these to technical appendix:
```
- Reserved SKU identifier and min capacity
- Allowed model list (including quantized variants) with expected latency ranges
- Routing policy: primary region, secondary region, fallback tier
- Burst handling: limits and dedicated pool sizing guidance
- Telemetry & tagging spec for marketplace attribution
```

jeff-finance: Also add a renewal incentive: if customer achieves >=90% of commit in months 7-12, increase next-year discount by 2% (to reward hitting the ramp). if <60% then reduce discount by 3% and trigger clawback. Clear thresholds help sales.

ana-partners: I'll draft bundled private-offer term sheet with: onboarding credit cap 25%, amortization schedule, routing appendix, MDF ask, and renewal thresholds. will share in this thread EOD.

rajesh-legal: I'll put a short template for clawback and audit clauses here when ready.

liz-gpmkt: Timeline: need draft press kit two weeks before public signoff. if partner misses MDF commitment, we postpone joint PR.

deploy-bot: Branch created: partners/1743201123-bundled-concierge-offer-draft.

marta-sales: Thanks — will review branch and loop in SI PMs. :white_check_mark:
